about: What's new on the landing card and the source of every GitHub Release. A PR that changes what a user sees, hears or downloads appends one entry to the END of unreleased. Never write releases by hand: publishing a release on GitHub moves every unreleased entry under its version, on the live branch printfins.com deploys from, not on main. An entry: {pr (optional: the merged PR number), date, check, text (one line), summary (optional, the longer release body: [{check, items[]}])}. check is held, stays, clean or easy (all for a roll-up).

unreleased.text: First tagged release: Auto and Full coverage fins, curved and arc walls, a bed pad and sway braces, tines that release clean, and the same engine in the site, nine slicer and CAD plugins, a CLI and an MCP server.

items: Auto: tined walls, wedges, a bed pad and sway braces under every overhang that needs them
Full coverage: every red overhang gets support, including figures (second pass, long walls along the part's length, ribs on thin and tall walls)
Curved, downhill and arc walls that follow an overhang to the plate; rim walls under a level overhang's free outline; flat overhangs get walls that cross the slicer's bridge lines
Draw mode: straight or curved walls, down to 2 mm, with squat walls where a full wall won't fit
A bed pad and optional rounded bed feet keep walls attached to the plate
Sway braces anchor a leaning part; walls are tied into a frame and braced when tall or thin
Plate only: every support on the build plate, none on the part
Tines kiss the part's surface instead of biting in, with Tine grip, spacing and Support gap settings
Supports export as their own 3MF object, with an interface-material object for a toolchanger
Resin: pins that snap at the surface and windowed feet a scraper can get under
Calibrate menu: printable coupons to tune the fins to your printer
Import STL, 3MF, STEP or OBJ; several models on one plate with Arrange; section view and a view cube
Plugins for Orca, Fusion, Cura, PrusaSlicer, Blender, FreeCAD, Rhino, SolidWorks and Onshape, plus a command line and an MCP server for AI clients
Nozzles from 0.2 to 2.0 mm, layers up to 0.6 mm, a phone-friendly layout, and German, Dutch, Portuguese, Chinese and Arabic
